summary: Website update: community map page should use a Google Earth-like interactive map with pins indicating where each user lives.
architectural_notes: Community map page requires an interactive map provider (e.g., Google Maps/Earth-style) supporting user-location pins/markers.
known_issues: Current community map is "not right" compared to desired Google Earth-like map behavior.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- High-resolution equirectangular Earth day texture, realistic satellite-style (earth-day-texture.dim_2048x1024.jpg)
- Equirectangular Earth night lights texture (earth-night-texture.dim_2048x1024.jpg)

existing_features.title: Replace the current 2D world map in `frontend/src/components/community/CommunityMapPanel.tsx` with an interactive Google Earth-like 3D globe that supports rotate and zoom, while keeping the existing Community Map page framework (page layout, member directory, and selected-member details card behavior) intact.

Render a pin/marker on the globe for each community member returned by `getCommunityMapProfiles()` that has `coordinates`, positioning markers using latitude/longitude on the sphere surface, and allow selecting members by clicking their pin.
Use new static Earth texture asset(s) for the globe surface and load them from `frontend/public/assets/generated` (do not fetch textures through the backend).
Add a graceful fallback UI if the user’s environment cannot render the 3D globe (e.g., WebGL not available), using an English user-facing message within the map card area.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update the community map page to use a Google Earth-like map experience with pins for each user's location

projectName: Update Community Map to a Google Earth-like 3D globe with member location pins
